summary: Defines a Sieve extension that lets a mail filter push a notification when a message arrives, instead of making users poll for new mail. It leaves the notification method open, expecting things like XMPP or SMS to be used. This is a Proposed Standard, updated by RFC 8580.

eli5.summary: Instead of checking your mailbox again and again, the mailbox can ping you when a letter comes. This lets mail rules send that ping.

questions: how to get push notifications for new mail with sieve
